user.title: Wiener Linien Austria
user.description: What do you want to add?

stop.title: Wiener Linien Austria
stop.description: Pick the stop you want to track.

data_description.diva: Start typing to filter the full stop list — the ones nearest your Home Assistant location are shown first. Partial names work: submit and pick from the matches.

select_lines.title: Lines at {stop_name}
select_lines.description: Found {line_count} lines currently serving this stop. Pick the ones you want to track.

data_description.scan_interval: Minimum 30 seconds — twice the conventional 15-second floor circulated for the OGD endpoint, for safety margin under shared-IP scenarios.

route.title: Route
route.description: Pick where your trip starts and ends.

data_description.origin_diva: Start typing to filter. Stops nearest your Home Assistant location come first.

route_options.title: {origin} → {destination}
route_options.description: Choose how connections are planned and when they refresh.

data_description.min_transfer_minutes: Changes with less time to spare than this are marked tight.
data_description.step_free: Plan only with lifts or ramps instead of stairs and escalators, and with low-floor vehicles.
data_description.leave_minutes: Minutes before the best connection leaves that the “Time to leave” sensor turns on.
data_description.active_from: Optional. Outside this window the route doesn't refresh. Set both times or neither.
data_description.scan_interval: Minimum 120 seconds. The route also refreshes right after the best connection leaves.

error.query_too_short: Enter at least 2 characters, or pick a stop from the list.
error.no_matches: No stop matches that. Check the spelling, or pick from the list.
error.invalid_stop: That stop is no longer in the catalogue. Pick another one.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Wiener Linien real-time API. Try again in a minute.
error.route_stop_unresolved: Pick a stop from the list. Typed names must match exactly one stop.
error.same_stop: Start and destination are the same stop. Pick two different stops.
error.window_incomplete: Set both a start and an end time, or leave both empty.
error.route_too_close: These stops are too close together to plan a trip. Pick stops further apart.
error.route_stop_invalid: The trip planner doesn't know one of these stops. Pick a different stop.
error.cannot_connect_routing: Can't reach the Wiener Linien trip planner. Try again in a minute.

abort.stop_gone: This stop is no longer in the Wiener Linien catalogue. Delete and re-add.
abort.catalogue_unavailable: Cannot load the Wiener Linien stop catalogue. Try again later.
abort.already_configured_route: This route is already set up.

rate_limited.title: Wiener Linien rate limit hit
rate_limited.description: Wiener Linien replied with error 316 (rate limit exceeded) to polls for **{entry_title}**. The conventional minimum interval circulated for the OGD endpoint is 15 s; this integration defaults to 60 s and enforces a 30 s floor, so normally this issue only appears when many HA instances share the same outbound IP. Raise the scan interval or reduce the number of concurrent entries.

catalogue_unavailable.title: Wiener Linien stop catalogue unavailable
catalogue_unavailable.description: The static stop catalogue (Open Government Data) could not be downloaded during configuration. The line picker fell back to a live-only probe, which omits any currently out-of-service lines (e.g. nightlines polled during the day, or seasonal services). Re-run the configuration once the OGD endpoint is reachable to get the full picker.

plan_trip.name: Plan trip
plan_trip.description: Finds trips for a configured route or between two stops, soonest first.

config_entry_id.name: Route
config_entry_id.description: A route you've set up. Leave empty if you fill in From and To instead.

origin.name: From
origin.description: Where the trip starts: the stop's name or DIVA number, such as Stephansplatz.

destination.name: To
destination.description: Where the trip ends: the stop's name or DIVA number, such as Westbahnhof.

datetime.name: Time
datetime.description: Leave empty for now. Arrive by decides whether this is when you leave or when you arrive.

arrive_by.name: Arrive by
arrive_by.description: Off: you leave at this time. On: you arrive by this time at the latest.
